assets.title: Original Little Jizō
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single original desktop app icon concept for Irodori, a personal photo editor. On a genuinely transparent background, depict a very cute small seated Jizo-inspired stone guardian, centered and completely visible, front-facing with an oversized smooth round head, short pebble-like body, compact hands held together, peaceful closed-eye smile, and one muted vermilion red bib. Make the stone warm pale silver-gray, softly sculpted matte ceramic/stone with restrained fine surface texture and gentle broad shading. A friendly original character, respectful and quiet, no elaborate religious attributes. Icon silhouette first: approximately 82 percent canvas height, broad shapes, modest grounded proportions, crisply defined edge, recognizable head/body and red bib when reduced to 32 pixels. No platform tile, no surrounding scene, no text, letters, characters, watermark, border, stand, rays, extra props or other figures. True transparent alpha outside the object; do not paint a checkerboard. A polished, tactile editorial illustration, not a photograph of an actual statue.
